svg.title: 03 Examine joint outcomes and imposed shocks
svg.desc: Three panels show every fitting draw of simultaneous returns of the first two synthetic assets. The probabilistic regime mixture is separate from imposed correlation and crash stress sets; the stress sets are not assigned occurrence probabilities.
svg.text: 03 Examine joint outcomes and imposed shocks
MODELLED SCENARIOS · Fitting draws · Same axis scales · One-observation simple returns
The mixture uses the next-state probabilities after the observed history. Stress distributions are deliberately imposed assumptions.
Only two asset dimensions are displayed; optimisation uses all four. These finite scenarios cannot exhaust possible market outcomes.
